steps.prompt: Before the check: which idea from this unit feels easiest now, and which one still trips you up?

cards.title: Percents, ratios and averages: quick review
cards.body: $p\%$ of $x$ is $\frac{p}{100} \times x$, and each percent is of a particular number: up $20\%$ then down $20\%$ multiplies by $0.96$. A ratio $a : b$ means $a + b$ equal parts: find one part first. For rates, find the amount for one. For averages, turn every average into a sum; combine groups by their totals, never by averaging averages.

cards.title: Powers and shortcuts: quick review
cards.body: Use a common base: $a^m a^n = a^{m+n}$, $(a^m)^n = a^{mn}$, $a^{-n} = \frac{1}{a^n}$. Take square factors out of roots: $\sqrt{72} = 6\sqrt{2}$. Look for structure: $a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)$, common factors, and numbers near a round number.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which shortcut from this unit will you look for first on your next test?
